note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #8, Q2 2025 Harassment; exports 'mexico_2025_q2harassment.csv', not the table name) keeps INEGI columns bp4_1_1..bp4_1_9 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0625.csv (import delimited case(lower)) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step); code 9 set missing (lines 220-222 for bp4_1_1..3 outside 2024Q1, 232-237 for bp4_1_4..9). mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's 2025 Q2 data dictionary labels each BP4_1_n 'Situaciones de acoso: <situation>'; after stripping that prefix 8/9 labels are character-identical to the shipped item_text and to questionnaire 4.1 options in the same order, and the 9th (BP4_1_4) is the same situation in the 2024 wording (see Step 3b). Cross-check (route 9 style, server-side GROUP BY on the live table, no export): all 9 live item vectors reproduce the raw INEGI 2025 Q2 CSV after the .do's recode -- 18/18 item x level counts match (bp4_1_1 1/2 = 2264/21446, bp4_1_2 165/23543, bp4_1_3 355/23354, bp4_1_4 1265/22440, bp4_1_5 53/23656, bp4_1_6 582/23127, bp4_1_7 510/23190, bp4_1_8 954/22741, bp4_1_9 62/23638); code 9 counts dropped 7/9/8/12/8/8/17/22/17 (108 cells); no blanks, no skip routing into 4.1 (raw 23717 rows; live 213345 rows = 9 x 23717 - 108, over 23712 ids = 23717 - 5 respondents coded 9 on all nine items); no duplicate id x item. Words: item_text / section_prompt / instructions are the administered 2025 Q2 questionnaire wording (text_source=study_materials); all 13 Spanish strings (CP4, 4.1 stem, 9 options, 'Si'/'No') are found verbatim in the PDF's text layer (p.5) after whitespace normalisation and dot-leader stripping, and a 150-dpi render of p.5 was read to confirm. Step 3b, 2025 Q2 vs 2024 Q4 (batch_687), checked not assumed, against both PDFs' text layers: (a) CP4 REWORDED -- 2025 Q2 prints 'Ahora, le preguntare sobre situaciones...' where 2024 Q2/Q4 printed 'Ahora, quisiera preguntarle sobre situaciones...'; rest of CP4 identical. (b) Item 4 (bp4_1_4) REWORDED -- 2025 Q2 prints 'Le enviaron mensajes o publicaron comentarios sobre usted con insinuaciones, insultos u ofensas sexuales a traves del celular, correo electronico o redes sociales (Facebook, X [antes Twitter], WhatsApp, etcetera), que a usted le molestaron u ofendieron' where 2024 Q4 printed '...sobre usted, con insinuaciones sexuales, insultos u ofensas sexuales, a traves del celular ... redes sociales (como Facebook, ...'. INEGI's 0625 diccionario still carries the 2024 wording for BP4_1_4; the questionnaire (what was read) was shipped. (c) 4.1 stem, items 1-3 and 5-9, and 'Si'/'No' identical to 2024 Q4. Live item set identical (9 = 9, bp4_1_1..9). Kept as printed: '(a)'/'(o)' gender fills, 'videos' in item 8 vs accented 'vídeos' in item 9, both as printed, 'etcetera' in items 4 and 8. Normalised: line wraps joined with a space. Stripped: question number 4.1, option numbers, dot leaders and I__I boxes, interviewer direction 'MUESTRE LA TARJETA "D" Y REGISTRE EL CODIGO CORRESPONDIENTE A CADA OPCION'. Tarjeta D is not in the questionnaire zip and was not transcribed. Structure: one section (all nine items are options of question 4.1); CP4 in instructions, the 4.1 stem in section_prompt, as in batch_678/687. Options: 1 = 'Si', 2 = 'No' printed in the questionnaire and identical in all 9 catalogos; 9 'No sabe / no responde' has no row (set missing by the .do). English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation): reused verbatim from batch_687 for every unchanged string; CP4 and item 4 re-translated for the 2025 wording. INEGI publishes no English questionnaire. The IRW dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2025 Q2 (file suffix 0625) wave -- same defect as the siblings.
